newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Swiss Re advises Baltic air insurance pool.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re advises Baltic air insurance pool.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance has helped work out a plan to form a pool of insurers for the small airline insurance market in the Baltic states of Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania, insurance companies and newspapers said on Thursday.
The pool of 14 firms includes the Lithuanian state-owned insurance company, which has the biggest slice of the work, four Estonian companies and Latvian firms.

"We are targeting small and medium-sized aircraft at the moment," Jaan Marks, chairman of one of the Estonian companies, Bico Insurance, told Reuters. He said the firms gathered in a pool as they were not able individually to insure airlines.
Estonian business newspaper Aripaev said Swiss Re helped formulate the pool as it was interested in forward insuring of the pool.
